p4_b5.ocr: The trial also emphasizes the technical aspects of genomic analysis, as evidenced by metrics such as the input amount of DNA (1000 ng) and the coverage levels achieved during library preparation, utilizing the KAPA LTP kit from Kapa Biosystems.
